patterns.note: Asymmetrical product showcases where a single product image is paired with descriptive text and price, often offset by a unique graphic element or illustration.
Prominent use of a custom, highly decorative script typeface for the main brand logo and select large section titles, serving as a primary visual motif.
Alternating light (off-white/cream) and dark (charcoal/black) background sections to create distinct visual breaks and emphasize content.
A sticky navigation bar that transforms on scroll: the initial large, stylized 'Clue' logo within the nav shrinks and simplifies, and the nav gains a solid background as it fixes to the top.
Editorial-style atmospheric imagery and video sections are interspersed throughout the page, breaking up product displays and reinforcing the brand's aesthetic.

technique_notes: A navigation bar that initially sits below a large hero logo, then becomes sticky at the top of the viewport on scroll, simultaneously transitioning its internal logo to a smaller, simplified version and gaining a solid background.
A full-width video background is used in the initial hero section, playing on a loop to create an immersive visual experience.

Complex, stylized SVG animations (potentially Lottie files) are embedded within various content sections, playing continuously or on a loop to add dynamic visual interest and reinforce brand identity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, custom-script display text (~5x body) for brand identity, paired with an elegant serif for headings and a clean sans-serif for body and UI elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on product bottles and some UI elements, but generally sharp edges for layout blocks and text containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in hero and between major sections, creating a sense of luxury and allowing elements to breathe; balanced density within product grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a custom, highly stylized script typeface as a central visual art element, integrated into both the brand logo and large section titles, sets a unique, luxurious, and artistic tone that goes beyond typical branding.
